injection_allowance_note: No applicable positive injection-current allowance found in retrieved manufacturer datasheet. Drive/sink and ordinary leakage ratings are not injection allowances.
assumptions: 5.5V is a conservative USB input screening level, not a verified source output
15.75V is a +5% PD15V screening level, not a guaranteed contract tolerance
29.2V is secondary exactCID TVS supplier clamp metadata at6.8A10/1000us, not a guaranteed bus transient upper bound
conditional clamp-current calculation assumes MCU pad clamps exactly at the absolute-limit offset; diode IV and dynamic behavior are not specified
conclusion: Series resistor dividers limit available current but do not guarantee pin-voltage compliance or permissible injection/backpower. 10nF VM filtering reduces slew but does not prove rail ordering. Firmware and ADC sampling settings cannot protect an unpowered input.
release_resolution: Manufacturer written permission for exact pins, currents, timing, rail states andtemperature, with measurement and guaranteed worst-case bounds; OR

Guaranteed hardware isolation/protection with exact supplier MPN data proving off-state behavior, all pin absolute limits and prevention of unintended rail backpower over full input/transient/temperature conditions.
candidate_architectures: V3V3-pulled open-collector transistor host detector, source-domain drive isolated from GPIO; firmware polarity changes and thresholds require review
VM analog switch/buffer with explicitly specified power-off protection; input voltage, off leakage, sequencing and ADC settling must be verified
Qualified discrete pad clamps only if maximum forward voltage and rail current-sinking/backpower behavior guarantee compliance; generic Schottky-to-VDD is not sufficient by itself
bench_required: Scope VDD/IOVDD and both GPIO voltages simultaneously with low-capacitance probes; capture Vpin−VDD through attach/removal, DATA-only/PD-only/both orders, 5Vfallback andreset
Measure ghost rail voltage and source current during partial power; a steady DMM result does not qualify short transients
Test source/cable/input ramps, component temperature and measured worst-case voltage with probe error margins; physical tests alone do not grant a missing injection specification
